You are role=sol in the authorized SafeInvest team. Read AGENTS.md and .runtime/task.json. Complete only that task in this worktree. Do not commit, push, change branches, edit the task, or start another watcher; the parent runner handles delivery. Respect allowed_paths and base version. Write real deliverables and perform checks. Report blockers rather than inventing parameters. The task is authorized; continue through routine fixes.
Read AGENTS.md, the locked problem/accounting and the exact source contract. SOL-013 approved corrected v2 design; its negative kernel verdict is retained and K1 is reviewed elsewhere. This task only reviews the new PERSONALIZED_REVIEW handoff and its companion JSON against that accepted design. Do not repeat the entire accepted design review or certify absent code.

Challenge the mapping from ten generic profile/fee recommendations to at most ten personalized cases. Referrals must remain null without a simulated fallback; selected fixed classes keep their mode/fee/fold prior, change only the generic threshold to their own tolerance, and evaluate only their own H. No adaptive substitution, outcome-dependent threshold tuning or new class search. An invalid upstream assignment/hash is an error, not a referral. Both risk and purchasing-power screens must be rerun. Explain any extra assumption/ambiguity requiring a chief correction.

Specifically examine separate primary .0025 and .005 counterfactual assignments. The .005 class can differ as a reported hypothetical but cannot automatically overwrite the primary recommendation, and different-class results cannot certify robustness of the same policy. Check consistency with POLICY_ANALYSIS and v2, including the independent generic Balanced same-primary-mode robustness test. This handoff does not authorize live trading or claim a personalized loss cap.

Construct a few concise rational/scalar synthetic reference fixtures independently of any production helpers. Show threshold equality at a completed post-fee/year-end value causes next-review latch; final-year crossing gives no fictional H+1 review; pending holdings keep exact dollars, pay no fee and still earn returns; p90 can pass despite strict tolerance exceedances; risk-only and purchasing-power-only failure mean referral with no reselection. Verify no/partial/all assignments produce ten summary rows and the correct conditional ledger, decision and metric counts, nulls and source-key requirements. Profile B's unchanged 25% rule must require exact H15 prefix equivalence. These are reference logic checks, not implementation or investment outcomes.

Write findings.json/review.md with exact reviewed source and design_verdict approve/changes_required, blockers, precise fixes if necessary, independent facts and scope limits. verification.json is exclusive-create; verify.py --check recomputes read-only, verifies pinned Git source and artifact hashes, permits HEAD to advance and rejects deliberately corrupted scratch evidence without repairing it. Preserve meaningful failures and do not hide a supported negative verdict behind a PASS label. Work within 15 minutes, CPU-only.

Only audit/SOL-020 plus ignored scratch writes are authorized. No source, tests, specifications, tasks, queue, runtime helpers or private-team edits. No actual CSV outcomes, policy code execution, production driver/adapter implementation, packages, watchers, worker restarts, task dispatch or final access. The runner owns receipt/push; chief reviews exact evidence and controls downstream implementation.
